sloka: ततस्ते रावणामात्यैरमात्याः पार्थिवस्य तु ।सूदिताश्चापि ते युद्धे भक्षिताश्च बुभुक्षितैः ।। ७.३२.३२ ॥
transliteration: tataste rāvaṇāmātyairamātyāḥ pārthivasya tu ।sūditāścāpi te yuddhe bhakṣitāśca bubhukṣitaiḥ ।। 7.32.32 ॥

translations.english: Subsequently, Arjuna's ministers were killed and even devoured in battle by Ravana's hungry ministers.
